pluginText.pf.visit: {"checkIn":"one check-in code per table, given at the host stand; the host texts it or types it on the Today page, or taps the name (marked done); away: the code from whoever is at the door","grace":"15 minutes after the time; then the host may give the table away and mark a no-show","atTheTable":"the server checks the allergy note with the party before ordering, and checks ID for alcohol (21 and over), the restaurant's own steps","changes":"a bigger party is seated only if a table fits; a cake service or anything extra is said before it's added","waitlist":"a freed table is offered by text to one party at a time, 15 minutes to take it; walk-ins join the same list at the host stand","done":"the check-in code (or the name tapped) proves the visit; away, DONE from the chef"}

pluginText.pf.rules: {"listing":"where the state's rules require it, a signed listing agreement before any table is offered (a switch from the state form)","fees":"a no-show fee only with the customer's yes when booking, and only within the state's limits","alcohol":"alcohol only to guests 21 or over with ID; bar service only under the liquor license","records":"booking records 7 years; allergy notes deleted the morning after","showPermit":"show a permit number where the state's rules require it","contracts":"a written event agreement above the amount the state's rules set, for cooking away"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"partySize":"the party grows or shrinks: re-seated if a table fits; dropping under 6 releases the saved card","lateParty":"the table is held 15 minutes; a text saying they're late keeps it if a table is still free","runningBehind":"the table before runs long: the host texts LATE, the party is told, and can change with no fee","noShow":"marked by the host after the grace time; any fee only from a saved card, only once the owner confirms","weather":"patio times close when the forecast is over the owner's limit; the party is offered inside or a new time","allergy":"a severe allergy the kitchen can't serve safely: the party is told before the visit, and can cancel with no fee","walkIns":"walk-ins join the walk-in list, apart from the booking waitlist; they pay at the table and carry no $2","waitlist":"a full day: the party joins the waitlist; a freed table is offered to one party at a time, with 30 minutes to take it","sentNow":"never: a table is booked ahead or walked in, and a chef shops and preps first, so nobody is on call","default":"every other edge case is handled the generic way"}
